name: The Great Outdoors

angles.text: Campfires and wilderness survival are the foundation of cooking in the field. Learning camp craft naturally complements your cooking.

faq.answer: Kaga teaches newcomers how to survive in the wilderness. She shows them how to rest by a campfire and prepare to learn trades.
Kaga is a traveler who teaches newcomers the basics of wilderness survival. At her campfire, they can learn to rest and recover.
Boosted Rest is the state gained by sitting beside Kaga's Basic Campfire. It reflects the restorative effect of resting at a wilderness camp.
faq.q: What is the Boosted Rest buff?

faq.answer: After learning the basics of resting in the wilds, you can learn from artisans in nearby settlements how to craft specialized camp fixtures.
Learning to make camp and recover stamina helps you survive beyond civilized towns. Sitting by Kaga's campfire lets you gain rested recovery between journeys.
faq.q: Why does Kaga have you sit by the campfire?

faq.answer: After learning to rest in the wilds, seek out profession trainers in the nearby village. They can teach you a trade and recipes for trade-specific camp fixtures.
faq.q: What should you do after completing this lesson?

sections.body: Kaga shows newcomers how to endure the wilderness beyond civilization. Courage alone cannot keep you safe there. You also need to know how to make camp and withstand the open elements.
sections.title: Lessons of the Wild

sections.body: Kaga's campfire gives weary travelers a place to rest. Sit beside it to gain the Boosted Rest buff. Once you know how to rest in the wilds, Kaga urges you to visit artisans in a nearby settlement. They can teach you tradeskills and how to craft camp fixtures.
sections.title: The Hearth and the Craft

summary: At Kaga's wilderness camp, newcomers learn how to rest and recover. From the campfire, they go on to nearby artisans to learn tradeskills and craft camp fixtures.
